look_here_first: Pine muhly (Muhlenbergia dubia): densely tufted narrow-leaved perennial with erect slender stems and a narrow contracted panicle. Confirm with membranous ligule (about 4–10 mm) and measured spikelets (about 3.8–5 mm); never identify from habit alone.

project_inclusion.range_basis: County-level native status not certified from the old source name.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Do not count as native in target county metrics pending BONAP/NAPA evidence.

best_field_traits: Perennial tuft with narrow often rolled blades
Narrow contracted inflorescence rather than broad plume
Measure true membranous ligule, commonly 4–10 mm
Check mature spikelets under magnification, approximately 3.8–5 mm
